title: Case: Parcel locker unavailable, recipient notified and reroute pending
context: A delivery attempt to a parcel locker has failed because the unit is temporarily out of service. The recipient has already been notified and the carrier's scheduling team is arranging an alternative. The desk must recognize when a fix is already in motion and avoid redundant contact.
initial_request: Determine whether the desk should contact anyone about DL-922.

events.from: Driver dispatch log, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-922 (Brineleaf Pantry, frozen goods) could not be delivered to Meridian Court parcel locker (unit 4B) at 10:15 UTC. Locker reported offline since 09:00 UTC by facilities team. Recipient was notified of the outage by our system alert.

DL-922 assigned to next available same-zone route. Reroute to recipient's registered address (74 Hartley Street) is confirmed for 2026-02-15 afternoon delivery window. Locker 4B repair request filed with site management; ETA 48 hours.
Got the locker alert. Your dispatcher already told me delivery is going to my address this afternoon. Just confirming that's still on track.

must: recognize that the recipient has been notified and has received confirmation of the reroute
acknowledge that Scheduling control has already arranged the alternative delivery
log the case as acknowledged and pending the afternoon delivery attempt
not contact Scheduling control or the recipient again
must_not: send a message to Scheduling control asking for an update or reroute
contact the recipient with information about the locker outage or the reroute
escalate to a human supervisor as if the situation were unresolved
request that facilities repair the locker immediately

rationale: Marcus Thorne has already been notified of both the locker failure and the alternative delivery arrangement, and he is confirming receipt of that information rather than asking for help. Scheduling control has already confirmed the reroute to his address for this afternoon. No action by the desk is required; sending another message would be redundant and would add noise to an already-managed situation.
